info.name: EventSphere Backend API (Phases 2 - 8)
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman test collection for EventSphere backend covering Phases 2 through 8:
- Actuator & Health (Phase 2)
- Authentication & Security (Phase 4)
- Core Exhibitor Functionality (Phase 5)
- Attendee Directory, Connections & Privacy Enforcement (Phase 6)
- Interactive Agenda, Live Sessions, Q&A & Polls (Phase 7)
- Organizer Console & Event Operations (Phase 8)
